import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=education_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age vs Total Spending scatter with Income color
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Age'], df['TotalSpending'], c=df['Income'], 
                     alpha=0.6, cmap='viridis', s=30)
ax2.set_title('Age vs Total Spending\n(colored by Income)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Income', fontsize=9)

# 3. Product Category Spending Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_totals = df[product_cols].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
product_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_cols))
ax3.barh(product_labels, product_totals.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Product Category', fontsize=11)
for i, v in enumerate(product_totals.values):
    ax3.text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
channel_data = {
    'Web': df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(),
    'Catalog': df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(),
    'Store': df['NumStorePurchases'].sum(),
    'Deals': df['NumDealsPurchases'].sum()
}
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel')
ax4.pie(channel_data.values(), labels=channel_data.keys(), autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Campaign Response Analysis
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5']
campaign_acceptance = [df[col].sum() for col in campaign_cols]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5']
bars = ax5.bar(campaign_labels, campaign_acceptance, color=sns.color_palette('muted'))
ax5.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances', fontsize=10)
for i, v in enumerate(campaign_acceptance):
    ax5.text(i, v, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 6. Family Composition vs Total Spending
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax6.plot(family_spending.index, family_spending.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#e74c3c')
ax6.set_title('Avg Spending by Number of Kids', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Kids at Home', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Marital Status Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax7.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, 
        color=sns.color_palette('Set3', len(marital_counts)))
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
